proper-project-planning.intent: What can go wrong when a software migration starts without a plan?

injection.intent: How do developers prevent injection under OWASP Top 10 2025 A05?

owasp-top-ten.intent: What changed in OWASP Top 10 2025 and what should developers check?

side-projects-keep-me-sane.intent: Why do side projects help me stay curious about programming?

why-i-journal-as-dev.intent: How can keeping a developer journal help me learn from daily work?
why-i-journal-as-dev.description: How a developer journal helps me capture lessons, spot learning patterns, revisit debugging decisions and prepare concrete performance-review examples.
